snippet.title: THE OFFICE ROOMS - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Step into the Offices of Productivity Analysis.
An infinite facility of white corridors, locked doors, and strange anomalies awaits. Every anomaly features dark satire on office life, the future of work and AI, and escapism.

The Office Rooms is a surreal walking-sim inspired by Severance and Backrooms lore, blending liminal exploration with unsettling corporate satire.

🔑 Wishlist now on Steam to enter the anomaly:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1925940/THE_OFFICE_ROOMS/
